authors_reviews.title: To be used not only by outdoorsy types & survivalists, but for outdoor insulated cat shelters!
authors_reviews.text: Size does matter and it was the first thing that attracted me to this blanket vs the others that were smaller. It really is true, big things do come in small packages and this is a pure example of 10 large size ‘blankets’ that could probably fit in a snack size single serve bag of chips. I ordered these specifically for the cold front that was coming in and the shelter being constructed for the outdoor stray cats. It wouldn’t be anything too fancy, but the blankets would be worked into the exterior layer of the structure to hold in the heat from the cats and the heating pad (similar to using mylar in a greenhouse with lamps). It’s the perfect solution!!! It’s inexpensive, lightweight, takes up little space, easy to work with (unless you puncture it), waterproof, wind resistant, and most importantly it is extremely effective at reflecting 90% body heat back at you. Anyway, it’s great to have the extras that I can store in the car, house & backpack in case of blizzard, avalanche or other no heat emergency situations. One blanket was tested outside (43°F w/wind) on my husband (6’4” wearing short sleeves) and he found it effective in coverage & keeping his entire body warm. As for the cats? When they do come out from their shelter they are warm & toasty! Fur and ears are warm to the touch, and noses have returned to their normal pink! Did you know you can use their nose as a temperature gauge? Anyway, as the saying goes, ‘it’s better to have and not need, than to need and not have’. I’m not only glad to ‘have’ these blankets as part of my emergency & greenhouse supplies, but it’s common sense. Mylar blankets are not only for outdoorsy types and survivalists, but for everyone’s safety & emergency kit. Who would of thought a “polar vortex” would bring so much snow to Louisiana or Florida? What if it happens again and you lose power? -Be prepared. Overall, this is exactly what I was looking for: large size, good quality, apparently durable, and at a good price point. When spring comes about, I’ll probably place another order for use in the greenhouse. Highly recommend! +Cats recommend!
authors_reviews.author: Lokiamus

authors_reviews.title: Swiss Safe Emergency Mylar Thermal Blankets: A Lifesaver in Challenging Situations
authors_reviews.text: I recently acquired the Swiss Safe Emergency Mylar Thermal Blankets, and I must say they are an absolute essential for anyone who values preparedness and safety. These thoughtfully designed blankets have proven to be a lifesaver in challenging situations, and I am thoroughly impressed with their quality and functionality.One of the standout features of these blankets is their construction. Made from durable and tear-resistant mylar material, they are designed to withstand harsh conditions and provide reliable insulation. The blankets effectively reflect and retain up to 90% of body heat, ensuring that you stay warm even in cold environments. This is particularly crucial in emergency situations or during outdoor activities where hypothermia and exposure are potential risks.The compact and lightweight design of the blankets adds to their practicality. Each blanket is individually packaged, making them easy to store, carry, and distribute. Whether you're a hiker, camper, or simply an individual who values preparedness, these blankets are a valuable addition to your emergency kit, backpack, or car.Another impressive aspect of the Swiss Safe Emergency Mylar Thermal Blankets is their versatility. They offer a range of uses beyond their primary function as emergency blankets. They can be used as ground covers, makeshift shelters, or even as a signaling device due to their reflective nature. The inclusion of four blankets in a single pack ensures that you have ample supply for various needs or for sharing with others in need.Furthermore, the bright orange color of the blankets enhances visibility, making them easily identifiable in emergency situations or when used as a signaling device. This feature is particularly beneficial in outdoor settings or during search and rescue operations.The overall quality and attention to detail in the design of these blankets are commendable. The edges are reinforced to prevent fraying, ensuring their longevity and durability. The material is odorless and non-toxic, which adds to their safety and usability.In terms of value for money, the Swiss Safe Emergency Mylar Thermal Blankets are an excellent investment. Considering their high-quality construction, versatility, and the fact that they come in a pack of four, they provide exceptional value and peace of mind.In conclusion, I highly recommend the Swiss Safe Emergency Mylar Thermal Blankets to anyone in need of a reliable and versatile emergency preparedness solution. Whether you're an outdoor enthusiast, a frequent traveler, or someone who wants to be prepared for unexpected situations, these blankets deliver on all fronts. With their durability, effective heat retention, and multiple uses, they are an indispensable tool that can potentially save lives. Invest in the Swiss Safe Emergency Mylar Thermal Blankets and be ready for any situation that comes your way.

They would be great for any of those situations, but I also plan to buy more to put some in each of our cars- they would be perfect to have in case your car breaks down or you get stranded in cold weather. authors_reviews.title: Lightweight, Compact, and a Smart Must-Have for Any Emergency Kit
authors_reviews.text: The Swiss Safe XL emergency Mylar thermal blankets are exactly what you want from a survival essential—simple, ultra-light, and designed to retain heat when it matters most. This 10-pack is especially practical for anyone building out a car kit, camping setup, or home emergency supply.Each blanket is individually packed and folds down incredibly small, which makes them easy to store just about anywhere—glove box, backpack, first aid kit, or emergency bag. Despite how thin they are, they reflect and retain body heat effectively, which can be critical in cold or unexpected situations.The XL size is a big advantage. Compared to standard space blankets, these offer better coverage, which helps trap more warmth and allows for wrapping or layering more comfortably. The material is durable enough for short-term emergency use without tearing easily when handled carefully.These are especially useful for:Emergency roadside kits and vehicle preparednessCamping, hiking, and outdoor survival situationsFirst aid and shock prevention in cold conditionsDisaster preparedness kits at homeBackup warmth in power outages or unexpected weatherThey also work well beyond just warmth—can be used as ground cover, wind barriers, rain reflectors, or even makeshift signaling materials thanks to their reflective surface.Overall, this is a low-cost, high-value item that earns its place in any emergency kit. You don’t think about it until you need it—but when you do, it can make a real difference.
